about: One thing playing at a time (docs/specs/media.md 5 and 6.6): `starts` says whether something starting (an attachment, or a card pressed) stops another already playing or shown; `off_screen` whether something stops when its row scrolls away. An embed's player is kind `video`. Leaving the conversation stops everything. Every client agrees on every case (lumia_core::playback).

starts.why: an attached video starting, an attached video playing: starting a video pauses any other (5)
an attached video starting, attached audio playing: starting one pauses any other: audio plays on only until another starts (5)
an attached video starting, a site's player playing: a site's player playing goes back to its card when an attachment starts (6.6)
an attached video starting, a site's audio playing: a site's audio plays on only until another starts (6.6)
an attached video starting, a site's post playing: a post is being read, not played: it stays
attached audio starting, an attached video playing: starting one pauses any other (5)
attached audio starting, attached audio playing: audio plays on until another starts (5)
attached audio starting, a site's player playing: a site's player goes back to its card
attached audio starting, a site's audio playing: a site's audio plays on only until another starts
attached audio starting, a site's post playing: a post stays
a site's player starting, an attached video playing: pressing a card pauses any attached video or audio (6.6)
a site's player starting, attached audio playing: pressing a card pauses any attached video or audio (6.6)
a site's player starting, a site's player playing: pressing a card puts back any other embed (6.6)
a site's player starting, a site's audio playing: pressing a card puts back any other embed
a site's player starting, a site's post playing: one embed shown at a time: a post goes back to its card too
a site's audio starting, an attached video playing: pressing a card pauses any attached video or audio
a site's audio starting, attached audio playing: pressing a card pauses any attached video or audio
a site's audio starting, a site's player playing: pressing a card puts back any other embed
a site's audio starting, a site's audio playing: pressing a card puts back any other embed
a site's audio starting, a site's post playing: one embed shown at a time
a site's post starting, an attached video playing: pressing a card pauses any attached video or audio
a site's post starting, attached audio playing: pressing a card pauses any attached video or audio
a site's post starting, a site's player playing: pressing a card puts back any other embed
a site's post starting, a site's audio playing: pressing a card puts back any other embed
a site's post starting, a site's post playing: one embed shown at a time

off_screen.why: an attached video pauses when its row scrolls away (5)
attached audio plays on until another starts or the conversation is left (5)
a site's player goes back to its card when its row scrolls away (6.6)
a site's audio plays on until another starts or the conversation is left (6.6)
a post scrolled past stays shown: nothing is playing to stop
